0022600026.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-6) host the Boston Celtics (6-2) in the Hornets' 10th game of the season. Charlotte is 10th in the East and on a five-game losing streak, while Boston is 3rd in the East, has won its last game, and is 5-0 at home. Charlotte is missing Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (leg soreness), and Boston is without Devin Carter (illness) and Jayson Tatum (rest), while Payton Pritchard is day-to-day with an eye abrasion and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Hornets lost 1-2 to Boston in 2025-26, including a 113-102 loss in Boston on April 7, 2026.
